slides.title: Two drone strikes, one Tigray village
slides.body: Medebay Terer, Tahtay Koraro woreda. Addis Standard, Oct 27, 2026

slides.title: civilians killed in two strikes, residents say
slides.body: On Oct 9 and Oct 21 in Medebay Terer. Six more were injured and taken to hospital in Shire.

slides.title: Oct 9: a clinic was hit
slides.body: Residents said a couple who brought their daughter in labor to the clinic were killed. Four others were injured, including the new mother.

slides.title: killed in a home on Oct 21
slides.body: Around 9 p.m., residents said: a father and his four children, including an eight-year-old girl. Two others were injured.

slides.title: Not independently verified
slides.body: The accounts come from residents. The report does not say who operated the drones, and no official response was reported.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate independently.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica, Oct 27, 2026 (residents)
